blocks.html: If there's something good that came out during the lockdown; it would probably be at home with your furbabies 24/7. When pet owners suddenly had to stay home and work-from-home, a lovingly newfound bond developed. As we gradually enter into a new phase and begin to open our doors once again, Robinsons Malls eagerly welcomes us back with a new amenity, we and our pet dogs will surely enjoy - Robinsons Malls Pet Park. Robinsons Malls through its Happy Pets Club program launches its first indoor pet park, located at Robinsons Magnolia, Level 2. This new facility is where dogs and their humans can have the best quality time, rain or shine! The spacious doggo pet park spans more than 70 square meters and can easily be found through its colorful fences and installation. In partnership with Top Breed, the pet park is equipped with obstacle modules designed for healthy pet exercises, a grass carpet (so it is paw-friendly), and a wide assortment of pet toys. Pet poop bins and a water fountain are within reach should your doggies need to take a break. A photo wall is also provided as your quality time will not be complete without a snap or two. The pet park can accommodate small to medium-sized dogs, upto 50 pounds and is open everyday, 11 am until 7 pm. Many lucky pets experienced the pet park during its grand opening. Among these are Baby Ginger, Calvin, Milky, Safina, Lexus, Gunther, Brent, Freya, Baby Shamcey and Dugyot – the winners of Robinsons Magnolia’s Paw-tastic Halloween photo contest. What’s more, the Paw-tastic Halloween Party, held in the pet park, was a blast and attended by the cutest furbabies you'll ever find! Treats, courtesy of Top Breed, No Brand, Robinsons Supermarket, True Value, and Daiso Japan were overflowing too! This marks only the beginning of a series of presents , perks and surprises Robinsons Malls Happy Pets Club has in store for pets and pet parents. Watch out for the opening of the newest pet park at your favorite Robinsons Mall!

About Robinsons Malls Happy Pets Club: Robinsons Malls Happy Pets Club is a fast growing community of animal lovers and responsible pet owners. Be a member of Robinsons Malls Happy Pets Club now! Go to any Robinsons Malls near you and simply fill out the Happy Pets Club registration form and submit an updated vaccination record together with a 1x1 photo of your pet.
